'''Professor Jacuzzi''' (Japanese: '''シャクジイ博士''' ''Dr. Shakujii'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG065|Gulpin it Down]]''. 

He has studied {{p|Gulpin}} for over 50 years and leads a small town, somewhere between [[Verdanturf Town]] and [[Petalburg City]], in its efforts to combat their annual Gulpin attacks. Professor Jacuzzi's first plan involved a giant [[Pokéblock]] to lead the Gulpin away. However, {{TRT}} ended up stealing the Pokéblock and the Gulpin chased them out of town. The Gulpin then tried to escape through the sewer and later emerged onto the streets. 

Professor Jacuzzi arrived with his Mach III Particle Cannon, a device inspired by Gulpin's {{m|Stockpile}} and {{m|Spit Up}} attacks, that beams objects up and shoots them away. The invention malfunctioned with one Gulpin left to go after accidentally beaming [[Ash's Treecko]] along with the last Gulpin. Gulpin used {{m|Spit Up}} while inside the machine, which reacted with the system's particles and made both Pokémon become {{pkmn2|giant}}. The two then continued their battle, although Treecko eventually returned to its normal size. Professor Jacuzzi, meanwhile, {{pkmn2|caught}} the large Gulpin with a [[Heavy Ball]], ending the year's Gulpin attack.

|desc={{p|Gulpin}} is Professor Jacuzzi's only known Pokémon. This Gulpin first appeared among a large swarm of Gulpin that swarmed his town in ''[[AG065|Gulpin it Down!]]''. When Professor Jacuzzi used his particle cannon to rid the city of the Gulpin, this Gulpin was the last one remaining. However, at that point, the Professor's machine broke down. Once he got it working again, however, he accidentally absorbed {{AP|Treecko}}, along with the Gulpin, as the two were battling at the time.

Due to Gulpin's use of {{m|Spit Up}}, both Pokémon [[Giant Pokémon|grew to gargantuan proportions]]. Treecko and Gulpin continued fighting in the city until Treecko returned to its proper size and Professor Jacuzzi attempted to capture Gulpin. He first used a regular {{i|Poké Ball}}, but it failed. He then threw a [[Heavy Ball]], which succeeded in catching the gigantic Pokémon. Although certain that catching it would have returned Gulpin to normal size, the Professor discovered upon sending out his newest Pokémon that it was still giant. Although he promised {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} that he would find a way to return Gulpin to its normal size, it is unknown if he has succeeded.

Gulpin's known moves are {{m|Sludge}}, {{m|Stockpile}}, and {{m|Spit Up}}.}}
